description: Provider families for the captain fleet. Maps quota-axi provider ids to harnesses and model-id patterns. Not a credential store.

providers.label: Claude
weaknesses: no native live-web preference over Grok

providers.label: ChatGPT / Codex
weaknesses: model windows can be tighter than account windows
live-web research is not the primary strength

providers.label: Cursor
strengths: good when Cursor plan headroom is healthy
weaknesses: quota-axi often cannot compute effective remaining for Cursor
not a Firstmate primary harness for fleet spawn in all homes
providers.notes: Cursor quotaSemantics are frequently unknown; treat headroom as disclosed uncertainty, not zero.

providers.label: Grok (xAI)
weaknesses: consumer credit windows may be unavailable while auth is usable
not the default for deep multi-file refactors
providers.notes: authStatus usable with empty windows is uncertainty, not logout.

providers.label: Kimi (Moonshot AI)
weaknesses: newer provider with less track record

harnessNotes.pi: Pi coding-agent; model ids are provider/model. Can host anthropic, openai-codex, xai, moonshot families when authenticated.
harnessNotes.claude: Claude Code / Claude CLI native harness.
harnessNotes.cursor: Cursor agent/composer path when the home supports it as a spawn harness.
